messages:
Maya (AE): HelixCorp want a 2-week POC next month. Must support SAML SSO, SCIM users+groups, RBAC mapping, and domain verification for tenant-lock. Also need Dedicated vs Private pricing + brief SLA for auth handoff. Need to reply by EOD Tue. Any blockers?

Owen (SE): We can do IdP-initiated & SP-initiated flows. Ask them for IdP metadata XML, preferred NameID format, and whether they require encrypted assertions. Need group claim key for RBAC mapping.

Pri (Security): From questionnaire: require RSA-SHA256 signing, SCIM over TLS1.2+, SCIM via OAuth2 client_credentials with rotation every 90 days, and audit logs retained 365 days for compliance. Legal will expect SOC2 attestation and DPA for Private.

Diego (Eng): SCIM: support full import + delta. Default rate-limit 50 req/min; can be increased for Dedicated/POC. Nested groups need flattening on client side or we can provide a helper script. Example minimal SCIM user we accept: ```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "sara@helixcorp.com",
  "externalId": "hc-4521"
}
```

Renee (RevOps): For pricing I'll need MAU and estimated tokens/mo. Can we get a ballpark? We can include a 30-day POC credit and a side-by-side Dedicated vs Private cost sheet.

Maya (AE): Customer estimates ~1k MAUs at POC, ~2.8M tokens/month. They'll likely escalate to ~5k MAUs if POC is successful. They also asked about tenant-lock across subdomains and multiple root domains.

Owen (SE): Tenant-lock: we issue a DNS TXT token for each domain to prove ownership. We can also accept a signed email from a domain admin if DNS isn't possible. For multi-root orgs we provide multiple tokens.

DeployBot: scim-connector/v3.2 deployed to staging  smoke tests passed \u2705

Pri (Security): Potential blocker: HelixCorp asked for EU-only residency for identity data. If confirmed we need EU Dedicated or EU Private and Legal DPA addendum. Lead time ~3 business days.

Diego (Eng): Private install checklist (short): allow outbound to control-plane (443), exchange mTLS certs, provide maintenance window for upgrades. We'll provide a step-by-step runbook if they choose Private.

Renee (RevOps): Action: I'll draft a POC quote with the credit and a Dedicated vs Private comparison. Need MAU/token confirm by EOD tomorrow to lock pricing.

Owen (SE): Action: I'll request IdP metadata and a sample SAML response + sample SCIM payload. I'll also prep a short SAML+SCIM quickstart and RBAC CSV template.

Maya (AE): Thanks team  I'll ask HelixCorp for EU residency confirmation and schedule a 30-minute call for Thurs 9am PT. Will loop you all in. :rocket:
